instruction: From the latest email in the Notes folder, extract the third image from the attached document and save it to /home/user/extracted_image3.png

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting the 3rd image from the Word document attached in the most recent email in Notes folder and saving it to /home/user/extracted_image3.png. Verified by checking the saved image has correct dimensions (510x474 pixels) from the actual document attachment in the Thunderbird profile.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the task end state: a saved image file with correct dimensions
Getter properly extracts image properties (exists, width, height) from the saved PNG file at /home/user/extracted_image3.png
Metric correctly compares dimensions with appropriate tolerance (±5 pixels) to account for minor variations
Expected values (510x474) are verified from actual document attachment in Thunderbird profile, not guessed
Dimension verification provides strong evidence that the correct (3rd) image was extracted from the document
Data flow is correct: getter retrieves file from VM → analyzes with PIL → returns properties → metric compares
No postconfig needed since the image is saved to disk and can be read at any time
Getter handles edge cases properly (missing files return exists=False)
Complete coverage: while the task has multiple steps (open email, extract 3rd image, save), the evaluator appropriately verifies the end state rather than intermediate steps
